label: Callicoon (Sullivan County)
zip_caveats: "Callicoon" means two different places. The hamlet of Callicoon on the Delaware River (ZIP 12723) is in the Town of Delaware, along with Hortonville (12745) and Kenoza Lake (12750); those voters get the Town of Delaware races. The separate Town of Callicoon (Jeffersonville 12748, Youngsville 12791, North Branch 12766, Callicoon Center 12724) has its own Supervisor and Highway Superintendent races. ZIP and post-office names don't follow town lines, so a 12723 mailing address can be in either town; your town is on your voter registration. Everyone in Sullivan County votes for NY-19, State Senate District 51 and the 3rd Judicial District, and both the Town of Delaware and the Town of Callicoon are in Assembly District 100 (the county's 2026 sample ballots for both towns). There are no county-level offices or county ballot questions on the 2026 Sullivan ballot, and the NYC proposals do not appear here. Check your registration and districts at voterlookup.elections.ny.gov. ZIPs are commonly used local ZIPs compiled for this guide, not an official crosswalk.

notes: Polls are open 6 AM to 9 PM on Nov 3. Town of Delaware (the hamlet of Callicoon, Hortonville, Kenoza Lake): Delaware Community Center, 8 Creamery Road, Callicoon (district 1), or Kenoza Lake Firehouse, 485 Old Taylor Road (district 2). Town of Callicoon: Youngsville Firehouse, 1822 Shandelee Road (districts 1 and 5); Callicoon Center Firehouse, 1669 Gulf Road (district 2); Callicoon Town Hall, 19 Legion Street, Jeffersonville (districts 3 and 4). Your election district is on your registration; not sure? Call 845-807-0400. Each town has its own sample ballot on the county's page. If you vote early, you can't vote on Election Day.

early_in_person.hours_note: Sullivan County early voting at two sites, Monticello (100 North Street) and Liberty (50 Community Lane); you can use either. Thu Oct 29, noon to 8 PM; Fri Oct 30 to Sun Nov 1, 9 AM to 5 PM.
early_in_person.hours_short: Early voting ends Sun Nov 1 at Monticello or Liberty; you can use either.
